text:
prateek: Quick follow-up on the small API we sketched last week for cross-mode request handoff. I think we should narrow scope to 3 primitives: route(), auth_delegate(), and metrics_hook(). Thoughts?

lisa: +1 to a minimal set. My concern is auth_delegate complexity for Private (customer KMS) vs Hosted (redwood KMS) — we need clear failure semantics and a safe default.

anil: Suggest making auth_delegate optional and requiring a capability token exchange for Private. If missing, runtime falls back to 'proxy-auth' mode and emits a warning metric.

marco: Proxy-auth increases latencies — measurable hit. We should define a latency budget for the handoff (p50/p95) and document where to throttle or degrade.

prateek: Agreed. Proposal: 5ms median for same-cluster handoffs, 50ms upper bound for cross-region/proxy. Surface these as SLO knobs per deployment and fail open/closed rules.

lisa: Observability question: we need consistent trace ids across modes. If control plane can't inject headers, runtimes must propagate redwood-x-trace from client requests. Also expose handoff phase in traces.

anil: Implementation sketch:
```
// language-agnostic pseudocode
interface Handoff {
  route(request): RouteResult
  auth_delegate(request, ctx?): AuthToken | null
  metrics_hook(ctx, tags)
}
```
Keep it intentionally small so adapters are easy to implement.

marco: That still leaks some control-plane semantics. Can we instead use an opaque Context bag so implementations can write headers/backchannel data without returning explicit tokens? Hosted returns token in Result, Private populates Context.

lisa: Opaque bag sounds fine, but we must standardize header names and error codes. Add a failure-semantics table: RETRYABLE, FALLBACK, HARD_FAIL with recommended actions.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: New canary for runtime-handoff v2 deployed to staging at 1729500120.

prateek: Migration path: 1) opt-in flag, 2) canary, 3) staged rollout, 4) forced migration if no regressions. Feature flag: runtime.handoff.v2 with behavior toggles (auth-mode: token|context|proxy).

anil: Edge case: Private tenants with strict egress policies — how do we get tokens without outbound to control plane? Add 'local-kms' shim that can mint ephemeral tokens locally; document required agent bindings and KMS policies.

marco: Perf test idea: simulate mixed tenancy at 100 req/s and measure p95. If v2 adds >10ms p95 compared to v1, abort canary. Also track cost delta (extra RPCs).

lisa: I'll draft a short RFC addendum with the interface sketch, error semantics table, and rollout steps. Please add any test scenarios or blocked deployment patterns you want included.

prateek: Thanks — pinging @lisa for the RFC addendum. Who can prototype a tiny Go/TS stub for the Context bag? That will speed adopters.

lisa: I'll open a PR with a Go stub + unit tests. Expect WIP by EOD. :rocket:

anil: :thumbsup:
